tool.name: Get.relabund
tool.description: Calculate the relative abundance of each otu
tool.command:
@SHELL_OPTIONS@
## create symlinks to input datasets ln -s '$otu' otu.dat &&
## collect the arguments of the mothur command in a list and join them with ## commas, so that the command can never end with a trailing comma #set $mothur_args = [] #silent $mothur_args.append("shared=otu.dat") #if $label: #silent $mothur_args.append("label=" + str(str($label).replace(",","-"))) #end if #if $groups: #silent $mothur_args.append("groups=" + str(str($groups).replace(",","-"))) #end if #silent $mothur_args.append("scale=" + str($scale))
echo 'get.relabund(${",".join($mothur_args)})' | mothur | tee mothur.out.log

param.label: shared - OTU Shared
param.help: Use Make.shared to create a shared file from a list and a group file

tool.help:
@MOTHUR_OVERVIEW@
**Command Documentation**
The get.relabund_ command calculates the relative abundance of each otu in a sample from a shared_ file and returns it as the ``relabund`` dataset.
.. _shared: https://mothur.org/wiki/shared_file/ .. _get.relabund: https://mothur.org/wiki/get.relabund/
